newsitem.title: USA: WMX Technologies director to tender shares.
newsitem.headline: WMX Technologies director to tender shares.

text.p: WMX Technologies Inc said Monday it has been advised by Peter Huizenga, a director of the company, that he intends to tender a portion of the WMX shares he owns in a Dutch auction tender offer.
Huizenga, who will retire as a director when his term ends on May 9, owns about eight million shares or about 1.7 percent of the company's outstanding stock.
The Dutch auction tender offer is for up to 30 million shares, at a price not lower than $30 and not higher than $35. The offer is scheduled to expire at 2400 EDT April 28/0400 GMT April 29.
